title: The orthogonal cylinder {z + ιv + ι'w : |v| < s, |w| < h} is open
statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ and let ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝ^k → ℝ^{n+k} be linear isometries (ℝ^m = Euclid m) with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 for all v ∈ ℝⁿ and w ∈ ℝ^k, and assume that every x ∈ ℝ^{n+k} can be written x = ιv + ι'w with v ∈ ℝⁿ, w ∈ ℝ^k. Then for every z ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and all real s, h the cylinder C := {x : ∃ v ∈ B_s(0) ⊆ ℝⁿ, ∃ w ∈ B_h(0) ⊆ ℝ^k, x = z + ιv + ι'w} (open balls) is an open subset of ℝ^{n+k}.
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (s h : ℝ), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ x : Euclid (n + k), ∃ v : Euclid n, ∃ w : Euclid k, x = ι v + ι' w) → IsOpen {x | ∃ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, ∃ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid k) h, x = z + ι v + ι' w}
